handoffs.decision_needed: Independently review task 148's immutable execution binding, fail-closed runtime validator, migration behavior, redaction boundary, atomic denial tests, and adversarial fencing coverage; return approve or findings to CEO.
handoffs.summary: Task 148 implements bound-pilot runtime fencing across context, heartbeat, and completion and passes 104 focused, 183 Agent Company, and 58 PixWeave tests. Independent review remains required by the Phase C charter.

known_limits: This is only the Phase C fencing workstream; remaining Phase C workstreams and Phase D are not authorized or claimed complete.
No production service deployment, live-database mutation, or PixWeave source change was performed.
Independent Control & Reliability review is not included and cannot be self-issued by the implementer.
open_items: Control & Reliability Reviewer should independently review the pushed task 148 commit and evidence before the Phase C exit gate.
project_decisions: Runtime fencing remains opt-in to explicitly bound pilot tasks; unbound and explicit non-pilot paths return before enforcement.
Context compilation creates one immutable binding per task execution generation and binds the exact context bundle, build artifact set, evaluation policy, and principal registry state.
Principal and credential state are compared through a server-side canonical digest and are not disclosed in task context.
The same validator runs before context use, heartbeat renewal, and completion, with heartbeat and completion checks inside their existing transactions.
Existing bound executions without a new execution binding fail closed and must be recovered/reclaimed to compile a current generation context.
project_summary: Agent Company now fences explicitly bound pilot executions when build artifacts, evaluation thresholds/profile, assurance authority/credentials, context binding, or execution generation drift after context compilation, while preserving unbound and non-pilot behavior.
summary: Implemented and verified task 148's Phase C runtime fencing with strict RED-GREEN TDD, immutable per-generation bindings, atomic heartbeat/completion denial, restart and migration probes, compatibility controls, and cross-repository regression evidence.
verified_facts: The normalized initial RED run executed 36 tests and failed with seven failures plus one error before production controls existed.
Focused assurance/runtime verification executed 104 tests with all passing.
Agent Company canonical verification executed 183 tests with all passing.
PixWeave remained clean at d78094f26eb697c810899a40771a8af6dec7ce19 and its canonical suite executed 58 tests with all passing.
Clean temporary-workspace initialization and validation returned ok=true and created the expected immutable execution-binding schema.
Denied bound-pilot heartbeats and completions leave lease, executor, task, execution, audit, and event state unchanged in focused tests.
Unbound and explicit non-pilot heartbeat/completion response shapes remain compatible in focused tests.
